package rulefixtures

	_ "github.com/lib/pq"
)

// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

func initAPI(db *sql.DB) http.Handler {
	cache := NewRedisCache("localhost:6379")
	_ = cache
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	return mux
}

func initWorker(db *sql.DB) {
	cache := NewRedisCache("localhost:6379")
	_ = cache
}

type RedisCache struct{ addr string }

func NewRedisCache(addr string) *RedisCache { return &RedisCache{addr: addr} }
